concept: Hard-sun petting farm with celestial props
creativeDirection: Daylight location photography turns the illustrated and graphic sleeves into tangible objects staged in a real petting-farm paddock, using crisp midday realism and strong negative space.
scene: A wide 16:9 editorial photograph shot at eye level in a sunlit goat enclosure, with sandy ground, timber fencing, a few scrubby trees, and a cloudless blue sky; the camera faces a clean open paddock where one constructed surreal prop area interrupts the otherwise ordinary farm setting.

elements.element: the woman from reference image 1 appears as a life-size painted cutout statue seated sideways on a large physical golden five-pointed star mounted low above the sand, still looking upward, with a few small hanging planet props nearby

the child from reference image 2 appears once as a freestanding portrait panel built from narrow vertical slats, preserving the sliced image, red hood, hands-on-cheeks pose, and turquoise backdrop glimpsed between slats

the five people from reference image 3 are the main live figures, standing together in the enclosure feeding several goats, with one large white goat dominant in the foreground and smaller brown and black goats around them
the multicolored striped geometric letterforms from reference image 4 become painted wayfinding boards and fence panels in mustard, red, teal, orange, and blue, arranged with lots of white space
the angular red-and-yellow emblem from reference image 5 appears once as a small sharp ranch-brand sign mounted on a matte black feed bin
the short horizontal black line and sparse centered layout from reference image 6 inform a minimal white livestock placard standing in open space with a single black rule near center

the blue armored winged humanoid from reference image 7 becomes one large fabricated metal scarecrow-like sculpture at the back of the paddock, wings spread against the sky, with blue metallic surfaces and ember-colored paint accents

the caravan from reference image 8 appears parked beside the enclosure as a real cutaway trailer packed with the chandelier, fireplace, framed pictures, ladder with stacked chairs, mannequin torso, pineapple, red rotary telephone with green lizard, television, sailboat model, wall clock, tree trunk, autumn leaves, Dalmatian, and the seated person from reference image 8 hidden behind an open newspaper in a red chair

coverSummaries.album: Mellon Collie and the Infinite Sadness
coverSummaries.description: A vintage-style illustration shows one young woman with curled light-brown hair seated sideways on a large golden five-pointed star floating in outer space. She wears a draped dress in green, blue, and red tones and looks upward. The background is a deep blue star field with several softly rendered planets and crescent-like celestial forms scattered around.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a woman seated on a golden star
coverSummaries.people: one woman seated on a star looking upward

coverSummaries.description: A minimalist photographic cover on a white background features a centrally placed portrait fragmented into many narrow vertical strips. The image shows a blond child in a red hooded top pressing both hands to their cheeks, with a turquoise-blue backdrop visible through the sliced strips. The strips vary slightly in height, creating a staggered top and bottom edge.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a vertically sliced portrait of a child in red
coverSummaries.people: one child with blond hair in a red hooded top, hands on cheeks

coverSummaries.description: A color photograph shows five young men standing together in an outdoor animal enclosure, feeding and interacting with several goats. A large white goat dominates the foreground, with brown and black goats around it. Trees, fencing, and a sandy ground fill the background, while a broad green band occupies the top portion of the cover.
coverSummaries.people: five young men standing together feeding goats

coverSummaries.description: A stark white cover contains a centered arrangement of large geometric striped letterforms made from parallel curved and straight lines. The forms are separated into blocks and colored mustard yellow, red, teal, orange, and blue, creating a clean retro graphic composition with lots of empty white space around it.

A very minimal cover with a textured black background and a small centered band logo rendered in sharp angular red shapes with yellow inner edges near the upper middle. Beneath it is a short line of small gold text, leaving most of the cover as empty black space.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: an angular red-and-yellow emblem on black

coverSummaries.description: A minimalist white cover with widely spaced black serif text arranged in stacked lines and a short horizontal black line near the center. The composition is extremely sparse, with the text elements centered and surrounded by large areas of blank white space.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a short horizontal black line amid sparse centered text

coverSummaries.description: A dramatic fantasy illustration depicts a humanoid winged creature in metallic blue armor standing against a fiery cosmic background. The figure has a sharp, birdlike or demonic face with glowing eyes, intricate biomechanical body details, and large spiked feather-like wings spreading outward. The background mixes dark space-like tones with vivid red, orange, and magenta bursts.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a blue armored winged humanoid with glowing eyes

coverSummaries.album: The Very Very Best of Crowded House
coverSummaries.description: A whimsical illustrated cross-section of a caravan or trailer interior is packed with eclectic objects. Inside are a chandelier, fireplace with flames, framed pictures, a ladder with stacked chairs, a mannequin torso, a pineapple, a red rotary telephone with a green lizard on it, a television, a sailboat model, a wall clock, a large tree growing through the room, scattered autumn leaves, and a Dalmatian at the right. A seated person in a red chair is hidden behind an open newspaper, and the trailer sits on a single visible wheel above black grass silhouettes against a warm sunset gradient sky.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a crowded caravan interior filled with surreal household objects
coverSummaries.people: one seated person hidden behind a newspaper in a red chair

prompt: A wide eye-level 16:9 view across a real petting-farm goat enclosure under hard midday sun, sandy ground, timber fencing, a few scrubby trees, clean blue sky, with generous open space and crisp shadows; the five people from reference image 3 are the primary subject, standing together in the paddock feeding goats exactly as a documentary farm portrait, with one large white goat dominant in the foreground and smaller brown and black goats around them. To one side, the woman from reference image 1 is preserved as a life-size painted figure seated sideways on a large physical golden five-pointed star mounted just above the sand, still gazing upward, with a few small planet props suspended nearby; the child from reference image 2 appears once as a freestanding portrait made of narrow vertical slats, keeping the blond child, red hooded top, hands pressed to cheeks, and turquoise background visible through the sliced construction; the multicolored striped geometric letterforms from reference image 4 become clean painted fence panels and signboards in mustard yellow, red, teal, orange, and blue; the angular red-and-yellow emblem from reference image 5 appears once as a small sharp sign on a matte black feed bin; the minimal black horizontal line from reference image 6 becomes a sparse white livestock placard with a single black rule near center; the blue armored winged humanoid from reference image 7 stands at the back as one large fabricated metallic sculpture with spread spiked wings and glowing-eye detailing; the caravan from reference image 8 is a real cutaway trailer parked beside the enclosure, densely packed with a chandelier, lit fireplace, framed pictures, ladder with stacked chairs, mannequin torso, pineapple, red rotary telephone with a green lizard on it, television, sailboat model, wall clock, a tree trunk growing through, scattered autumn leaves, a Dalmatian at the right, and the seated person from reference image 8 hidden behind an open newspaper in a red chair. Photographic realism, daylight location shoot, crisp medium-format detail, no haze, no wet surfaces, clean edges, people’s faces sharp and unobscured. Composition gives the goats and the five people clear priority, with the golden star figure and the cutaway caravan as secondary anchors and the graphic signs as supporting accents. Palette of sky blue, sand tan, goat white, green, gold, red, teal, mustard, and matte black; playful, bright, surreal yet physically plausible. Reference map for people (the album images are attached in this numbered order): reference image 1 shows one woman seated on a star looking upward; reference image 2 shows one child with blond hair in a red hooded top, hands on cheeks; reference image 3 shows five young men standing together feeding goats; reference image 8 shows one seated person hidden behind a newspaper in a red chair. Copy each of these faces directly from that numbered reference image - same face, hair, expression, and styling - rather than drawing a new person from the description. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Keep each reference person in the pose, expression, and gaze the sleeve shows, and keep every identifiable face sharp, lit, unobscured, and in focus: no motion blur, long-exposure smearing, steam, fog, shadow, crowding, or shallow depth of field over a reference person's face. Expose the image brightly and cleanly: open, readable shadows and clear colour, with no murky underexposure, crushed blacks, heavy film grain, digital noise, or dust-and-scratches texture. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
